text: それだけの　うでが　あれば　ロケットだん　でも　えらく　なれるのに　もったいないぜ！

structure.jp: それだけの　うでが　あれば
structure.en: if you have that much skill

structure.jp: ロケットだん　でも　えらく　なれるのに
structure.en: you could become important even in Team Rocket, and yet

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. あれば comes from ある, 'to have'. うでが　あれば = 'if you have the skill'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though' and shows the speaker is sorry that things are not turning out that way. なれるのに = 'you could become one, and yet...'

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: なれる is なる, 'become', changed to mean 'can become'. えらく　なれる = 'can become important'.
